notes.title: Admine Update 1.03
notes.content:
Update 1.03 for Admine is live. Changes include: 

[list]
    [*] Fullscreen setting persists between game sessions.
    [*] Fixed spelling mistakes in various parts of the game.
    [*] Debug console is disabled by default; start the game with -debug flag or select "Developer Mode" launch option.
    [*] Added "Developer Mode" launch option that enables deeper logging and console.
[/list]

notes.title: Admine Update 1.01
notes.content:
The first public update to Admine is live, addressing several quality of life issues and providing bug fixes.
[list]
    [*] Fixed application window not centering properly on launch on certain screen resolutions.
    [*] Prevented console from overlapping the game executable.
    [*] Added a fullscreen toggle option to main menu.
    [*] Updated sprites for nearby mine indicators and mine warning highlight with outlines to improve their visibility and adjusted number 3 color.
    [*] Tutorial will not be replayed in story mode if the player successfully completes it.
    [*] Adjusted game saving behavior; game now saves the state when holding ESC to exit and will not automatically load the game if the save file is present.
    [*] Added a Continue button to load back the saved game if one is present.
    [*] Adjusted timing on certain speech-text entries and slightly increased the font of the speech-text to improve overall readability.
    [*] Added a binding to middle mouse button (scroll wheel press) for breach usage with mouse.
    [*] Hopefully fixed an elusive crash related to D language's garbage collection cycle.
    [*] ЙЦУКЕН keyboard layout should now work as well as QWERTY layout.
[/list] 
This is not going to be the last patch to the game in the nearest future; expect more room layouts, bug fixes and quality of life improvements!
